text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"བཱཛྫ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ནི་དེ་ཀུན་དུ་འབྱུང་བའོ།","english":"\"Vajja\" is not the arising of all that.","kind":"negation","why":"The source says it is the arising, but the English adds 'not'.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}
